name: Day One Atlas
headline: The GTA 6 field guide
tagline: Unofficial GTA 6 map, cheats, money methods and guides. Checked against multiple sources and updated as new info comes out.

tipJar.headline: Keep the atlas free
tipJar.message: Day One Atlas is one person checking every fact against multiple sources so you don't waste your evening on a fake cheat code. If it saved you time, a tip keeps it ad-light and updated.
